malta.name: Mastru Ġużepp Caruana
malta.title: Armourer of Birgu
greetings: Ah, back again. What needs mending?
Come in out of the sun. The forge is hot, but the stone is cool.
Every plate here was hammered in Birgu. Every one.
Merħba! You still have both arms? Good.
Say what you need. The Turk will not wait for us.
onBuy: A fine choice. It will serve you better than you deserve.
Done. Bring it back in one piece.
That steel came all the way from Milan. Remember that.
Grazzi. May it bring you home.
onSell: I'll give you a fair price. Fairer than the Sicilians would.
I can melt this down for nails, at least.
Hm. It's seen better days, like the rest of us.
Grazzi. Someone else will find a use for it.
onEquip: There. It sits well on you.
Tight in the joints, but it will loosen.
Now you look like a soldier.
Go on. Show the Turk what Maltese steel can do.
tooPoor: Not enough, sinjur. Steel is not cheap.
I cannot give it away. Even in a siege.

ottoman.name: Hasan Usta
ottoman.title: Quartermaster of the Cebeci
greetings: Hoş geldin, efendi. What does the Sultan's service require?
The armoury tents are open. Choose quickly.
Every blade here was counted at Istanbul.
Ah, efendi. The powder is dry, the steel is sharp.
Come. The guns of Marsa never sleep, nor do I.
Speak. The pasha does not wait.
onBuy: It is yours. Use it for the Sultan.
Good steel for a good warrior.
May it serve you as well as it served the last man.
onSell: I will put it back in the stores.
Hm. A fair price for worn steel.
The corps will find another hand for it.
onEquip: Now you are ready for the walls.
tooPoor: The treasury does not give credit.
Come back when your purse is heavier.
